sentences.text:
--------
CORAM : HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE AMBUJ NATH

--------
For the Petitioner : Mr. Pankaj Kumar Ravi, Advocate For the State : Ms. Anuradha Sahay, A.P.P  --------
06/ Dated 20.04.2023  Heard the parties.

The petitioner is apprehending his arrest in connection with Complaint Case No. 2361 of 2019, for the offence under Section 498A of the Indian Penal Code and 3 & 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act,
pending in the Court of Miss Anamika Kishku, learned Judicial Magistrate, 1st class, Ranchi.
Vide order dated 20.03.2023, notice was ordered to be issued to the opposite party No.2.
Service report is on record.
It appears that the opposite party No.2 has received notice but has not taken any step for appearance of any counsel before this Court.
Accordingly, this case is being disposed of after hearing the learned counsel for the petitioner.
Petitioner is the husband of the opposite party No.2.
It is alleged that after marriage, the opposite party No.2 was tortured to enforce the demand of dowry and ultimately, she was driven away from matrimonial home.

It was submitted that parties have settled the dispute and the petitioner shall pay the maintenance amount of Rs.5,000/- per month to the opposite party No.2 in the light of the settlement made before the Mediation Centre, Ranchi.
The opposite party No.2 has withdrawn the maintenance case.
It was further submitted that opposite party No.2 has not sustained any injury at the hands of the petitioner.

sentences.text: Learned A.P.P on behalf of the State has opposed the prayer for bail.

Considering the aforesaid fact;
I am inclined to extend the privilege of anticipatory bail to the petitioner.

He is directed to surrender before the court below within two weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this order and the learned court below on his surrender shall release him on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each, to the satisfaction of Miss Anamika Kishku, learned Judicial Magistrate, 1st class, Ranchi, or her successor,
in connection with Complaint Case No. 2361 of 2019, subject to the the conditions as laid down under Section 438 (2) Cr.P.C.
BS/ (Ambuj Nath, J.)
